tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi lo rgyus dbang chog sgrub thabs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs/ bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe sgrub khyad par 'phags pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ ras chung rdo rje grags pas te phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po'i drung du/ chos rnams rdzogs par zhus nas bod du 'byon par zhu ba byas pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i gsung gis de ring tshong dus su ltas mor song zhig gsungs nas/ ltas mo la byon pas/ rnal 'byor pa sngo sangs kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa phrag la bkal ba/ rwa dung 'bud pa zhig 'dug pa des spyan ce re ba zhig gzigs nas/ khyod la zla ba bdun gyi tshe las mi 'dug gsungs pas/ shin tu bred de/ bla ma'i drung du phyin te zhus pas/ khyod la tshe de las mi 'dug pa ngas kyang shes te ma smras pa yin/ da ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo zhes bya ba/ tshe dpag med dngos su 'grub pa zhig yod pas/ de'i drung du song la gdams pa zhus shig gsungs nas gser srang bzhi yod pa khyer te/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i drung du phyin nas/ srang gsum gyis chos yon byas/ srang gang gis chos zhu ba'i chas byas te dbang zhus nas zla ba bdun du bsgoms pas/ lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi sku tshe bsrings pa yin gsungs/ de snga bzhi bcu bzhes pa la/ de nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du bzhugs par gda'/ de nas te phu pa'i drung du log byon pa dang*/ bla ma'i gsung nas gdams ngag ngas kyang shes te/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo tshe ring bas yid ches pa'i gnas yin gsungs nas/ bla mas kyang tshar gcig rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas bod du byon/ mi la dang mjal ba'i dus su/ mi la'i gsung nas sngar bod du ma grags pa'i zab khyad can gyi chos shig nga la skyes su phul zhig gsungs pas/

chos 'di bla ma'i bka' ma chog par skyes su phul bar gda'/ 'di'i bye brag gi brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dbang phyug mi la ras pa/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ mnyam med yang dgon chos rje/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ kun mkhyen zur phug chos rje/ des bdag la'o// shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yi ger bkod pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las dbang chog bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe'i dzap la brten nas tshe sring ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla re dang*/ yol ba dgram/ tshe dpag med kyi lugs sku'am/ bris sku dgram/ sa stegs byas la pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'am me tog gi tshom bu lnga pa byas par chang las sbrus pa'i tshe zan la mar dang bu ram gyis brgyan pa dang*/ bum pa chang gis gang ba bzhag de'i mtha' mar ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma gsum bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag bskyed bsgom pa/ mdun bskyed bsgom ste tshe 'gugs shing bstim pa/ tshe dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ de nas/ swa bhā was bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar por bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas/ rang nyid tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bsgom/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ bde ba can nas tshe dpag med ye shes pa spyan drangs la mchod cing bstod nas rang la bstim/ de nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la mchod yon la sogs pas mchod la/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i mtha' mar/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te la sogs pas rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ a mā ra ṇi chos 'khor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer de 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams bskyed/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/

'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshe zan dang*/ tshe chang badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gong bzhin du gnyis ka tshe dpag med du bskyed/ de la ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma nang gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ dang po/ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ.oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas tshe dpag med la 'bul/ mchod bstod bya/ gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong gang byed la 'bul/ gsum pa gzhi bdag la a kā ros sbyin/ de nas tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin tshe'i bcud nyams pa rnams bsdus/ tshe dpag med dang bum pa gnyis su byon/ tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsam zhing*/ a mā ra ṇi ci nus su bzla'o// de bzhin du 'od zer spro bsdus 'byung ba sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyi bcud bsdus bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ tshe dpag med kyi bum par byon 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsam zhing*/ de rnams re re la'ang sngags

oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra he sogs/ re re'i mtshams su mchod bstod re bya/ sngags a mā ra ṇi/ brgya rtsa re las mi nyung bar bzlas pa bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba la gsum/ 'khor ba las blo ldog pa'i phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad de skyo ba bskyed pa/ lam gyi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'bogs pa/ dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po ni spyi dang mthun par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum blo dang 'dres nges rjes zlos byed du gzhug de nas sems bskyed 'bogs pa ni/ dgongs gsol sogs gong bzhin byas la/ 'gro ba bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir// sangs rgyas rnams dang sems dpa' che rnams kyis// ji ltar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i// byang chub sems de bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar spyod gyur pa'i// byang chub mchog gi spyod pa bla med pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis spyad par bgyi// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug go /gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

de nas slob ma'i tshe yar ba 'gugs pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du/ tshe dpag med gong bzhin bsgom du gzhug slob dpon gyis tshe zan slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la tshe dpag med du bsgom/ dpon slob gnyis kas 'di bzhin du bsgom ste/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ slob ma'i tshe dang bsod nams bdud dang gshin rje srin po dang ma mo rgyal 'gong la sogs pas khyer ba rnams 'od zer gyis rang dbang med par bkug bdud rtsi 'o ma'i kha dog lta bu phyogs bcu nas byung zhing*/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing*/ slar yang 'phel zhing rgyas par bsams la sngags bzla/ slob dpon gyis ngag tu/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig /tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa zhes sogs kyi bkra shis dang rol mo bya'o// oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal shing thog 'bru sman/ rin po che la sogs pa thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi ro bcud thams cad bsdus/ tshe dpag med kyi bum pa'i nang du byon/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ khol zhing lud pa bum pa'i kha nas mar zham byung*/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug 'phang lo'i mig gi rgya tsam kha dang de ba'i nang du song bas lus thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis khengs te lus sra zhing brtan pa gzhom gzhig mi nus pa ri rab dang rdo rje lta bur gyur par bsam/

'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig sogs dang*/ de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ chu'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i chu thams cad la phog ro bcud bsdu ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ lus snum bag dang ldan par bsam/ dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus me'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa me thams cad kyi ro bcud bsdus/ lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang 'od zer spro bsdus rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rlung thams cad kyi ro bcud bsdus/ lus stobs dang yang rtsal chen por gyur par bsam/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams bsdus/ tshe dang bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ lo brgya thub cing sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ tshe dpag med kyi bum par byon/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu/ bum nang du khol zhing lud/ bum pa'i kha nas zham byung*/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug nas mar song*/ khog pa'i nang thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis khengs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur/ lus sku rdo rje/ ngag gsung rdo rje/ sems thugs rdo rjer gyur pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dpral bar thim/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa sku'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byon/

slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhig tu bsam/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mgrin par thim/ gsung dbyangs drug cu rtsa bzhi thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang bral nas ye shes kyi rlung du gyur pa'i mgrin par āḥdamar por bsam/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar thim/ thugs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems mi rtog pa'i ye shes su gyur pa'i snying gar hūm̐ sngon por bsam/ yig 'bru gsum ka las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gnas gsum du thim/ tshur 'dus slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes lnga phrin las bzhi dang ldan par bsam/ lus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ ngag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje/ yid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ lus ngag yid gsum 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ de nas tshe zan gyi tshe dpag med slob ma'i spyi bo nas bstims la/ tshe zan dang tshe chang sbyin/ slob ma tshe dpag med du gyur pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsgoms la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyi bkra shis brjod do// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs la rol zhing yon dbul/ bla mas gtor mgron gyi lha la mchod cing bstod nas/

nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chang kha bskang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// tshe sring pa'i cho ga thun mong ma yin pa nyams su blang bde ba 'di/ shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lho 'o na 'dul bde chen kun gsal gyi ri khrod du yi ger bkod pa'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /khrid rin chen gter mdzod las bskyed chog bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dpag med bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs la/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs pas tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i steng na phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sku rags do shal la sogs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghāṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da'am/ skabs 'dir/ gtsang zhing ngam/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// zhes pa'i mchod phreng gis phul la/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod do// rang gi snying gar zla ba'i gdan la/ gzungs ring thung gi sngags 'khor ba la dmigs la bzlas pa bya/ de nas thun mtshams su gtor ma bya'o// tshe dpag med kyi mngon rtogs nyams su blang bde ba 'di nyid grogs dam pa dge grags pas bskul ba'i ngor gong ma'i gsung la brten nas/ snyom las pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las bstod pa bzhugs so// gdod nas rnam par dag pa 'od gsal zhing*// glo bur dri ma dag pa chos kyi sku// rig stong gnyis su med pa bde chen dngos// bcom ldan tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs mdangs ldan 'dab brgyad steng*// kha ba'i mdog can gdung sel ri bong can// de steng thugs rjes rjes su chags pa'i hrīḥ

/bcom ldan tshe dpag med la= /sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// skye 'chi g.yo med rang byung rtag pa'i sku// bcom ldan= /rin chen bum pa tshe yi bdud rtsis gang*// ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i steng du legs gnas pa// 'gro la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ster// bcom ldan= /zhi zhing 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan// mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rab brjid cing*// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan chas rab spras pa'i// bcom ldan= /tshad med 'od zer sku las rab 'phros pas// rab 'byams zhing gi mun pa'i smag rum sel// chos kyi snang bas phan bde'i lam ston pa'i// bcom ldan= /gsung dbyangs rgya mtsho gdul bya'i yid bzhin 'jug /ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs 'khrul pa sel// bden gnyis don la blo gros rgyas mdzad pa'i// tshe dpag med pa'i gsung la phyag= /rang byung ye shes 'od gsal chen po la// g.yo med rtag bzhugs rnam par mi rtog dang*// shes bya'i chos kun ma 'dres thams cad mkhyen// tshe dpag med pa'i thugs la= /stobs dang ma 'dres mi 'jigs bzhi dang ni// ye shes lnga dang byams pa chen po sogs// yon tan rgya mtsho kun nas lham me ba// tshe dpag med pa'i yon tan la phyag 'tshal// phyogs bcu'i zhing du sna tshogs sprul pa yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dren// sna tshogs mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// tshe dpag med pa'i phrin las phyag 'tshal lo// thog med las ngan rlung gis rab bskyod cing*// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khyil pa yi// gting mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che// 'khor ba'i chu bo che las bsgral du gsol// ma rig lta ba 'thibs pos non pa yis// blang dor lam la blo gros mig ldongs te// ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar zhugs pa la// ye shes sgron mes kun nas bsal du gsol// las dang nyon mongs du ma'i bud shing la// srid pa dam po'i rlung gis rab bskyod cing*// mi zad sdug bsngal me chen 'bar ba la// dam chos bdud rtsi'i char chen dbab tu gsol// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gcong nad can// 'khrul pa'i bag chags gdon gyis rab gzir ba'i// thar pa'i grogs dang bral ba'i skye bo la// stong nyid bdud rtsi'i sman mchog sbyar du gsol// g.yo med brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang*// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba che rnams kyi// ro bcud ma lus bdag gi dbang gyur nas// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'gro ba kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*// 'dod dgu ma lus bdag gi dbang gyur nas// na rga 'chi ba'i gnod pa dang bral ba'i// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje che rnams kyi// 'gyur med rtogs pa bdag gis thob pa yis// tshe dpag med pa tshe yi dbang phyug gi

/sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rtag brtan ther zug 'gyur ba med pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// khyod la cha tsam bstod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa rnams thar nas// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par shog /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la bstod pa 'di ni/ dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor// sgom chen pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lho spa gro skye chur sbyar ba'o// ༈ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba 'od dpag med// rig 'dzin brnyes pa grub pa'i rgyal mo dang*// gsang sngags mdzod 'dzin grub chen ti phu pa// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// zab mo'i bcud bsdus ras chung rdo rje grags// rtsa rlung sems la dbang thob mi la rje// sems dpa' chen po 'gro mgon sgam po pa// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i mtha' rtsa ba// rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa'i 'bri gung pa// gzhan don mthar phyin spyan snga rin po che// gsol ba= /dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal ba yang dgon pa// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab spyan snga rin chen ldan// snang srid chos skur rtogs pa'i zur phug pa// gsol ba= /grub pa bye ba'i thig le 'ba' ra ba// nyams rtogs rol pa'i gar mdzad rin chen 'phel// dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mdud zhig tshul rgyan zhabs// gsol ba= /don gnyis lhun grub mkhyen rab chos kyi rje// rdo rje'i gnas thob rje btsun kun spangs pa// rab gsal rnam 'phrul tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /mkhas shing grub brnyes 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// lung rtogs mtsho chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba=

/rgyal gsung mdzod 'dzin mgon po bka' 'gyur ba// mkhyen pa'i gter chen bsod nams mchog grub dang*// rin chen gsum dngos bstan pa gsal byed la// gsol ba= /srid zhi'i 'dren mchog blo gros chos 'phel ba// o rgyan lung zin ngag dbang ye shes dang*// 'gro ba'i ded dpon chos grags rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= /ngag la dbang 'byor chos kyi rgya mtsho'i mtshan// kun bzang dgongs brnyes chos dbyings rdo rje dang*// mkha' spyod mdzes mas rjes bzung blo gsal zhabs// gsol ba= /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i gar mkhan chos kyi rje// brtse chen bdud rtsi'i zer 'phro 'gro ba'i mgon// smra ba'i dbang po bka' drin sum ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// rje zur phug pa yan chad 'ba' ra bas mdzad pa la/ phyin chad brgyud pa'i kha skong gu ṇas so// byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las kun gyi bdag /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can la// snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// sbyang gzhi mi shigs rdo rje gsum dbang la// sbyang bya ma rig glo bur dri ma'i tshogs// sbyong byed rim gnyis zab lam rnal 'byor gyis// sbyangs 'bras gdod ma'i 'chi med mngon gyur shog /tshe khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sgom chen pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las khrid yig 'bring po bzhugs so// bla ma dang tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dpag med kyi nyams len 'bring po bya bar 'dod pas tho rangs kha nub phyogs su bltas la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/

tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i steng na/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i mthil du rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sku rags/ do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis mdun bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bum chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ de la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/

tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang la gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs thams cad la phog pas/ de yis rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang*/ mdangs dang*/ kha rje dbang thang la sogs pa brkus pa dang*/ 'phrog pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ yar ba thams cad bkug ste rang la thim pas sor chud par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla'o// yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi dang*/ ri rab dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ gangs can la sogs pa'i gangs ri thams cad dang*/ spos ngad ldan la sogs pa'i spang ri thams cad dang*/ ma la ya la sogs pa'i nags ri thams cad dang*/ brag ri dang*/ rdza ri dang*/ g.ya' ri thams cad dang*/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rigs thams cad dang*/ nas la sogs pa 'bru'i rigs thams cad dang*/ ga bur la sogs pa'i sman gyi rigs thams cad la phog pas/ rdo khab len gyis sa nang yod pa'i lcags kyi phye ma bsdus pa ltar/ de thams cad kyi bcud 'o ma'i kha dog lta bur skya na ra ra bsdus nas/ tshe dpag med kyi bum par byon pa khol zhing lud pas bum pa'i kha nas mar byung ste/ spyi gtsug gi bu ga nas mar song bas/ lus gang*/ sra zhing brtan la gzhom gzhig mi nus par bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ de bzhin du 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho la sogs pa chu thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pas lus snum zhing bag dro bar bsams la sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ me'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i me thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pas/ lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i bdud rtsi bstim/ mtshams rnams su sngags brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzla'o// yang ā yu ṣes gsol ba btab/ 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog

rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus/ khyad par du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa rnams kyi bcud bsdus pas/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang tshe dang bsod nams mnyam par bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa bzla'o// yang ā yu ṣes gsol ba gdab/ 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs bum par byon/ bdud rtsir gyur pa khol zhing lud/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus khengs pas/ lus sangs rgyas kyi sku rdo rje dang*/ ngag sangs rgyas kyi gsung rdo rje dang*/ sems sangs rgyas kyi thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsams la/ tshe gzungs brgya rtsa bzla// de nas tshe dpag med rang gi spyi gtsug nas mar thim par bsams la/ rang nyid tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// smra bcad byas nas zla ba gcig bsnyen pa byas na/ tshe zad pa yang lo bcu gnyis thub par gsungs so// tshe sring ba'i man ngag 'di las zab pa med do// tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgom bzlas kyi rim pa 'bring po nyams su blang bde ba 'di nyid/ sgom chen pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'ba' ra don grub sdings kyi yang dben du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod las khrid yig bsdus pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dpag med kyi sgom bzlas nyung ngu byed par 'dod pas/ tho rangs kha nub phyogs su gtad la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/

bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i steng na phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i mthil na/ rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sku rags/ do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ bum chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus gang chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ de la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ya/ shab+da/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/

rang la gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs thams cad la phog de rnams kyis rang gi tshe dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang*/ mdangs dang*/ kha rje/ dbang thang la sogs pa brkus pa dang*/ 'phrog pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ yar ba thams cad bkug ste/ rang la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ yar ba thams cad sor chud par gyur/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla'o// yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung rnams la phog de rnams kyi bcud bsdus/ tshe dpag med kyi bum par 'dus/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ bum pa khengs/ khol zhing lud/ bum pa'i kha nas mar la skya chil gyis byung*/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar byung bas khong pa'i nang mer gyis khengs pas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog de rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang thams cad bsdus nas/ tshe dpag med kyi bum par byung bas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ yar lud rang gi spyi gtsug nas mar byung*/ lus mer gyis gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsgom/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bum par byon 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ skya chil bum pa'i kha nas mar zham byung*/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas mar zhugs/ khongs pa'i nang thams cad khengs pas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ gong gi sngags bzla'o// sngags bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ tshe dpag med rang gi spyi gtsug na mar thim par bsams la/ de nas rang nyid tshe dpag med du bsgom/ snod bcud bsdus pas lus stobs dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags brgya rtsa zla/ 'di smra bcad byas nas zla ba gcig bsnyen pa byas na tshe zad pa yang lo bcu gnyis thub par gsungs so// tshe dpag med kyi sgom bzlas bsdus pa nyams su blang bde ba 'di nyid/

sgom chen pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ 'ba' ra don grub sdings kyi yang dben du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga pad dkar bzhad pa'i phreng ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phun tshogs pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po'i rtser// nyi gzhon 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes 'dra ba// bla ma rje btsun tshe dpag med pa'i zhabs// gtsug gi pad+mor rol pas ring du skyongs// mthar byed mun pa 'thibs pos dub rnams dang*// bde ldan pad+ma'i tshal du 'jug 'dod dag /dga' bas ut+pal 'dren byed lan brgyar phyis// legs bshad snyan brgyud 'od stong kho bos sbyin// de la rje btsun dbang mo ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mngon sum du gnang ba'i gdams pa/ skyes bu ras chung pa rdo rje grags pas bod yul du spyan drangs pa'i chos rnams kyi nang nas ches zab pa/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha gcig bum gcig gi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni gnas yid du 'ong bar tshe dpag med kyi bris sku sogs kyi drung du/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa'i dbus su/ chang dang*/ bu ram dang*/ mar dang*/ spos sna tshogs sbyar ba'i zan gyi tshe bum dmar po rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med par tshe chang bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba mgul chings dmar po can/ tshe'i ril bu ci rigs dang bcas pa lag len ltar bsham/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor pad 'dab can gsum/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas khor yug tu bskor ba/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la/

bdag bskyed sgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ phyag rgya sngags sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos rnams thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar la zhi ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na gser gyi bum pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas bklubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing*/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams bcug la phyag rgyar bcas pas mchod/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa// khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la// tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i// tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ na mo bha ga sogs gzungs ring dang*/ a mā ra ṇi g.yas skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi lus gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams bskyed/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas tshe'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ gzungs ring brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i snying po ci nus bzlas la/ slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal du gsol/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed kyi rim pa ni mdun gyi tshe zan/ tshe chang a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang tshe dpag med yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ mchod bstod gsol gdab rnams gong bzhin bya'o// de nas tshe 'gugs pa nas bzung snod bcud kyi bcud bsdu ba sogs 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin bsams la/ sngags rnams bzla zhing slar yang mchod bstod bya/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

'di'i rjes chog skabs/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu zhes snang bde ltar mdun gyi nam mkhar gtor mgron yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul du bskyed pa la gtor ma 'bul bar snang*/ spyir mdun bskyed la 'bul ba'am/ gtor mgron skad cig gis spyan drangs pa la 'bul kyang rung ste/ phyi ma la ye shes pa gshegs pa'am brtan bzhugs bya'o// dang po mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'bul/ gnyis pa rang gi sgos kyi chos skyong la de nyid kyi cho gas 'bul ba'am/ yang na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul/ gsum pa a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gzhi bdag la sogs pa la bsngo'o// ༈ /gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ snyims pa me tog dang bcas gral la 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched dang*/ gnas skabs su tshe la bar du gcod pa mtha' dag zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe'i dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du tshe yi dbang bskur ba'am byin gyis rlabs pa zab mo zhu snyam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab ste legs par gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen pos gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal ba'i rim pa dang rjes su mthun par/ dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa theg pa chen po yin la/ de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhir bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ 'dir brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung las rnal 'byor bla med kyi nang tshan/

ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'bum pa nas phyung bar bzhed la/ deng sang yongs grags la bod yul du bsgyur ba'i bya rgyud dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sngags la brten pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i chos skor 'di'i byung tshul gyi lo rgyus ni/ rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i sras kyi thu bo zla ba lta bu'i rje btsun ras chung rdo rje grags pa de nyid 'phags yul rgya gar du byon te/ grub chen te phu pa gsang sngags kyi sdong po dang mjal/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor la sogs pa zab la rgya che ba'i gdams pa du ma gsan nas/ bod du 'byon par chas pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i gsung nas bu khyod de ring grong khyer pha gir tshong dus su ltas mo la song zhig gsungs pa ltar byon pas/ tshong dus de'i phyogs gcig na/ ā tsa ra sngo sangs ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa phrag pa la bkal ba/ de'i rwa dung 'bud pa zhig 'dug pa des/ ras chung pa la spyan 'bru tshugs su ce re ba zhig gzigs nas/ rnal 'byor pa blo gros che la skye gzugs bzang ba zhig 'dug ste khyod la zla ba bdun gyi tshe las mi 'dug ang gsungs nas/ ga shed cig tu gshegs song ba dang*/ ras chung pa 'jigs shing skrag pa cig byung nas myur bar bla ma'i drung du byon nas/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhib par zhus pas/ bu khyod la tshe de las mi 'dug pa ngas kyang shes te/ yid ches par bya ba'i phyir der btang ba yin gsungs/ 'o na de 'dra'i 'chi ba zlog pa'i gdams pa cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas/ da nged rang gi gnas 'di nas thag mi ring ba zhig na/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i grub pa thob pa zhig yod pa de la/ rje btsun mas lung bstan te/ khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha tshe dpag med yin pas/ de la gsol ba thob gsungs pa ltar/ tshe dpag med kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas/

dus de nyid du zhal gzigs dngos su dbang bskur/ gdams pa gnang nas/ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes te/ da lta mi lo sum brgya dang bdun bzhes kyang*/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dbu skra nag po sil bur yod pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo zhig deng sang rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs tsan+dan de ba'i nags khrod na bzhugs kyin yod pas/ de'i drung du song la tshe sring ba'i gdams pa zhus shig ces lung bstan/ der ras chung pas gser srang bzhi yod pa khyer nas/ ma gcig gi drung du byon/ gser srang gang la tshogs 'khor gyi cha rkyen byas/ gser srang gsum maṇ+ḍal du phul nas 'di'i dbang dang gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par zhus te nyams su blangs pas mnal lam du lcags kyi srog pa rtsa chen po spyi bo nas btsugs pa rmis/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha'i byin rlabs las/ sngar khong gis bzhi bcu lon pa la/ de'i steng du bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bsrings nas/ kun dril brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du thub pa'i lung bstan khyad par can thob/ de nas ras chung pas te phu pa'i drung du log byon pas/ bla ma'i gsung nas gdams ngag de dag ngas kyang shes te/ ma gcig gis bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs shing tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes par grags pa che bas yid ches pa'i gnas yin pas der btang ba yin/ ngas kyang tshar gcig bya yi gsungs nas/ 'di'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas ras chung pa bod du byon te/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dang mjal ba'i dus su/ rje btsun gyi gsungs nas bu khyod kyi rgya gar nas gdams pa zab la mang ba lon yod 'ong bas/ de rnams kyi nang nas gtsigs su che ba/ sngar bod du ma grags pa'i zab chos khyad par can cig skyes su phul cig gsungs pas/ bla ma'i bka' ma chog par 'di nyid bla ma rje btsun chen po la skyes su phul bar gda' zhing*/ rje btsun chen po nas/

mnyam med dwags po lha rje sogs la rim par brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs sam/ ras chung lugs su grags pa 'di la phyi sgrub lha stong dang lnga brgya/ nang sgrub lha sum cu rtsa gsum/ gsang sgrub lha bcu gsum/ yang gsang de kho na nyid lha gcig bum gcig tu sgrub pa dang bzhi las/ 'dir zab pa'i yang rtse phyi ma nyid kyi sgo nas/ tshe yi dngos grub sgrub pa la'ang bzhi ste/ tshe yi byin gyis rlabs pa la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ bskyed rim la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ rdzogs rim la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ bcud len gyi ril bu la brten nas tshe sring ba dang rnam pa bzhi las/ 'dir de thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgrub par bya ba la gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa rnams grub zin nas/ da slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la'ang*/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ thog mar rdo rje slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba la/ tshe'i byin gyis brlab pa zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul snyam pa mdzod la maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod la/ der tshogs pa kun gyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba til gyi gong bu kha bye ba bzhin mngon sum du khra lam mer bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rang dang gzhan gyi sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs brjod/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum/ rjes su gnang ba'i gzhi 'god pa'i slad du/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas par mos mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ 'od gsal stong pa de nyid kyi ngang las/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i zhes sogs dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi byin gyis brlab pa la/ tshe gta' la brten nas tshe sring ba/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ tshe dzap brjod cing dbang gi lha bstim pa'o// dang po la/ thog mar tshe srog nyams pa gso ba'am tshe dgug pa'i slad du rdo rje slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun gyi tshe zan dang tshe chang bcom ldan 'das su gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ lcags sgrog gi rnam pa can phyogs bcur 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dang srog dang dbang thang la sogs pa/ bdud dang gshin rje/ btsan dang ma mo/ the'u rang dang rgyal 'gong la sogs pas khyer ba dang*/ 'phrog pa dang*/ brkus pa dang*/ yar ba dang*/ nyams pa la sogs pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye bsdus pa ltar/ rang dbang med par 'od zer gyi sna la bsdus te/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ zhu zhing khol/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shā ra re hūm̐/

zhes brjod pas/ bum pa'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zham zham lud rang gi tshangs pa'i bu ga 'phang lo gdangs pa lta bu'i nang nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag tshe srog nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing*/ 'chi med dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ slob dpon gyis kyang dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gsal ba'i ngang nas/ tshe bum slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag cing*/ dril bu gsil la/ ngag tu/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du shis pa brjod pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// bkra shis des kyang dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud bsdu ba ni/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi/ dbus kyi ri rab lhun po/ gser gyi ri bdun/

gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa/ phyi'i lcags ri khor yug ri bo gangs can la sogs pa gangs kyi ri/ spos ngad ldan pa la sogs pa spang gi ri/ ma la ya la sogs pa nags kyi ri/ ri bo rtse lnga la sogs pa brag gi ri/ bya rgod phung po la sogs pa rdza'i ri/ gzhan yang g.ya' ri dang*/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i ri/ mdor na sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal/ 'bru bcud shing thog sman la sogs pa sra zhing brtan pa sa yi rigs thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad kyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ ro dang bcud dang nus pa thams cad bsdus te/ bum pa'i nang du byon/ zhu zhing khol/ 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du gyur pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes gong bzhin sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ser po gser zhun ma'i khu ba lta bu lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ sngar ltar bsam zhing*/ khyad par du lus sra zhing brtan pa gang gis kyang g.yo ba dang gzhig par mi nus pa rdo rje pha lam dang*/ ri rab lta bur gyur cing*/ sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs sngar ltar bya zhing*/ de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// sogs kyi shis pa brjod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho dang*/ 'og gi rgya mtsho dang*/ nang gi rgya mtsho dang*/ chu gter ma dros pa dang*/ gaṅgā dang*/ sin+dhu dang*/ pak+ṣu dang*/ si tā la sog pa chu bo chen po bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang mtsho dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ lteng ka dang*/ bkod ma dang*/ gtsang po dang*/ chu klung dang*/ chu bran dang*/ chu mig la sogs pa brlan zhing gsher ba chu'i rigs thams cad la phog pas/ de dag gi sogs/ bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu/ khyad par du rang gi lus snum bag brjid dang ldan par/ gang gis kyang skam pa dang rengs par mi nus pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang*/

bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur cing*/ chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kis rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs dang*/ dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug sogs brjod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rta gdong gi me dang*/ sreg pa'i me dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi me dang*/ bskal pa'i me dang*/ ye shes kyi me dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ glog dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ rgyu skar la sogs pa'i 'od dang*/ mdor na tsha zhing sreg pa me'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad la phog pas/ de dag gi sogs dang*/ bdud rtsi drod kyi rang bzhin zangs zhun gyi mdog lta bu dang*/ khyad par du rang gi lus drod dang*/ bkrag mdangs dang*/ 'od zer phun sum tshogs pa gang gis kyang mog pa dang*/ mun pa dang*/ sgrib par mi nus pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ nor bu rin po che'i 'od zer lta bur gyur cing*/ me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mos rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// sogs brjod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ khyim gyi 'degs byed dang*/ ldeg byed dang*/ 'thor byed dang*/ skyod byed kyi rlung la sogs pa yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi rigs thams cad la phog pas/ de dag gi sogs dang*/ bdud rtsi ljang gu dang bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog khyad par du rang gi lus bde zhing yang rtsal dang ldan pa gang gis kyang lci ba dang*/ gnon par mi nus pa lha'i gos pañtsa li kā dang*/ srid med kyi bu lta bur gyur cing*/ rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol mas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// sogs brjod/ de ltar phyi'i 'byung ba rnam pa bzhi'i bcud bsdus pas/ nang gi 'byung ba bzhi cha mnyam par byas te/

'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa las byung ba'i nad bzhi dang*/ gdon bzhi'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gnas skabs su 'byung bzhi'i dwangs mas lus kyi zungs dang*/ sems kyi rten byed cing*/ mthar thug 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa rgyal ba yum bzhi'i go 'phang myur du mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// zhes brjod/ nang bcud kyi yon tan bsdu ba ni/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ khyab 'jug ste/ 'jig rten gyi gtso bo gsum dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ rgyal po chen po ste bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa mi ma yin stobs ldan thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal 'byor thams cad dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can rnams kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu/ rnal 'byor pa dang ku sā li rnams kyi rtogs pa'i yon tan/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba sogs 'jig rten gyi rgyal po dang*/ rgyal phran dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ blon po dang*/ btsan phyug la sogs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid mnga' thang*/ stobs dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad/ rdo khab len gyis sogs gong ltar/ bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ khyad par du de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad rang nyid kyis thob pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa sogs thun mong gi dngos grub rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs/ sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang*// sogs brjod/ yang 'od zer 'phros te steng phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yon tan dpag tu med pa bkod pa zhes bya ba dang*/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mtshan dpe/ gsung dbyangs/

stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i gang zag skyes bu zung bzhi/ gang zag ya brgyad la sogs pa'i yon tan/ zad par/ zil gnon/ rnam thar/ snyoms 'jug la sogs pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis sogs/ bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ khyad par du sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas/ lus ngag yid gsum dag pa'i rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsams la/ tshe bum mgo bor bzhag pa sogs/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// sogs kyi shis pa brjod do// de ltar nang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud bsdus pas/ gnas skabs su tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'di'i sgo nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug mgon po 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la/ mdun gyi tshe zan dang tshe chang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon rnams bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi dpral bar thim/ tshur 'dus pa las/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa'i sku'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas/ lus thams cad 'od zer dkar pos khengs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus sku rdo rjer gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhig lam gyis byung bar bsam/ gzungs ring brjod cing dril bu gsil/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mgrin par thim/

tshur 'dus/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi yon tan thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur pa'i mgrin par āḥdamar po bsam/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kar thim/ tshur 'dus/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i snying gar thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid thugs rdo rjer gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ slar yang yig 'bru gsum ka las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gnas gsum du thim/ de dag gi ye shes lnga dang*/ phrin las bzhi la sogs pa'i yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes lnga dang phrin las bzhi dang ldan pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur cing*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ sems 'dzin med du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag re re la'ang gzungs ring brjod cing*/ dril bu gsil ba gong ltar bya/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /gsum pa tshe dzap brjod cing dbang lha bstim pa ni/ tshe zan mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba 'di nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i steng du/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim bzhin tho brtsegs su bzhugs par mos la/

snying gi dkyil rkang gi khong*/ rus pa'i gting nas bcos ma ma yin pa'i mos gus drag po dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di dag gi rjes zlos kyang mdzod cig byas la dpon slob rnams kyis gdangs dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon yang*// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byon nas kyang*// 'dir tshogs skal ldan skyes bu la// tshe dbang zab mo'i dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzod cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo dang*// te phu gsang sngags sdong po dang*// ras chung rdo rje grags pa yang*// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren sogs kun la 'gre'o// dbang phyug mi la ras chen dang*// bka' brgyud dwags po lha rje dang*// bder gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal yang*// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= /'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po dang*// spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po dang*// rgyal ba yang dgon chen po yang*// gnas 'dir= /thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan dang*// zur phug rin chen dpal bzang dang*// 'ba' ra rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yang*// gnas 'dir= /rtogs ldan rin chen 'phel ba dang*// 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*// drin can mkhyen rab chos rje yang*// gnas 'dir= /rje btsun kun spangs chen po dang*// tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang*// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug kyang*// gnas 'dir= /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan yang*// gnas 'dir= /'jam mgon bsod nams mchog grub dang*// rin chen bstan pa'i gsal byed dang*// rje btsun blo gros chos 'phel yang*// gnas 'dir= /o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dang*// mtshungs med chos grags rgya mtsho dang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho yang*// gnas 'dir= /kun bzang chos dbyings rdo rje dang*// rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong dang*// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yang*// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

gnas mchog 'di ru byon nas kyang*// 'dir tshogs skal ldan skyes bu la// tshe dbang zab mo'i dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzod cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ rtsa brgyud gyi bla ma rnams tshe zan gyi tshe dpag med la thim/ de nyid 'od zer dmar po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam pa can du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad khengs pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs dkyus bzhin brjod/ tshe zan dang tshe chang gi lha 'od du zhu ba'i tshe'i bdud rtsi myong bar bsams la/ tshe ril tshe chang sbyin la de dag gis tshe'i dbang bskur ba'i dngos gzhi legs par thob nas/ gsum pa rjes ni/ de'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag kyang tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum dang*/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod rnams 'bul gyis cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi ltar/ bla mas gtor mgron mchod cing bstod/ yig brgya tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ 'bru gsum bkod pas gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ shis pa brjod pa spyi ltar bya'o// 'od dpag med pas rjes bzung ḍā ki ma'i// thugs bcud rnal 'byor dbang po grags pa'i zhabs// gang de'i gdams pa rgya mtsho'i nying khu 'di// 'khrul med dam pa'i drin las 'dir bshad do// shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i sngags 'chang dang*// skal ldan blo gros gsal ba'i slob bu dang*// snyan brgyud dri med mtsho chen 'dir zhugs la// dngos grub yid bzhin dpal gyis rol par mdzod// tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs lha gcig bum gcig tu grags pa/

yang gsang gi sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ gdams pa 'di'i snyan brgyud thog mar yi ger bkod par mdzad pa po 'ba' ra ba skyes mchog rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge gzhir bzhag phyag len gyi rim pa mthong brgyud rje bla ma'i gsung las 'byung ba ltar las dang po pa rnams la khyer bde ba'i phyir/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor mchod pa'i ban+de blo gsal gyis dge 'phel ri bo'i spo la gnas pa'i tshe sbyar ba'o// dge'o// ༈ /tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi byin rlabs cho ga pad dkar bzhad pa'i gsal byed gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa'i skabs/ sbyor ba'i dus su/ tshe ril tshe bum gyi mthar bskor ba de gas byed pa gzhung gi dgongs pa yin kyang*/ brgya rtsa sogs la stabs bde khyad dbus su mañdzi'i khar tshe bum/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang rnams bsham/ mdun bskyed kyi tshe de gsum ka lhar bskyed pas khyab/ dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams tshe zan gyi tshe dpag med la thim zhes pa'i mtshams/ de las rang pad+ma gnyis pa re byung ste 'od zer dmar mo sogs nas/ ro gcig tu gyur pa las/ lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i tshe ril dang tshe chang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'di dag kyang byin pa la brten nas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub kyi dga' ston gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la gzungs ring dang bcas tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ slar yang spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig mdzad pa la brten nas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog gi rnam pa can phyogs bcur 'phros pas/

khyed rang rnams kyi tshe srog dbang thang gdon bgegs 'byung pos khyer ba dang*/ 'phrog pa dang*/ brkus pa dang*/ yar ba dang*/ nyams pa la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ ro dang nus bcud thams cad dang*/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug 'khor los sgyur ba sogs khams gsum na mngon par mtho ba rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid mnga' thang*/ stobs dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus te mgon po tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ zhu zhing khol/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag tshe srog nyams pa sor chud 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma stobs su smin pas lus kyi zungs dang*/ sems kyi rten du gyur cing*/ rgyal ba yum bzhi'i ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlab/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ mthar bum pa'i lha las rang 'dra gnyis pa re byung ste khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la tshe bum mgo bor bzhag cing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/

bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes brjod/ gzungs ring bzla zhing tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rung re brjod/ de lta bu la grangs bzung nas grangs rdzogs pa'i tshe/ gzhan gong ltar la/ mthar spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag med 'od zer dmar po sogs dkyus ltar brjod pa khyad par ro// yang slob ma bla med kyi dbang gis ma smin pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa mi mdzad pas/ de ltar na bshad pa'i skabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi byin gyis brlab pa la/ tshe gta' la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ tshe dzap brjod cing dbang lha bstim pa'o sogs dkyus ltar dang*/ 'jig rten pas 'das pa'i bcud bsdu ba'i mjug skal ba can du byas pa yin no zhes pa'i rjes su gnyis pa tshe dzap brjod cing dbang lha bstim pa sogs sbrel lo// de la 'di nyid kyi sngags ni 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i le'u dang po las gsungs te/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di legs par bzlas na las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro// mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thung na 'brum bu 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro// lus las skyes pa'i dug mi bzad pa dang*/ spre'u'i dug dang*/ sbrul dug la sogs pa'i rma la yung ba dang a ru ra dang ru rta la sogs pa la yongs su bzlas te bskus na rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro// nad dang rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad la sngags mdud bcings na zhi bar byed do// rtag tu bzlas na tshe zad pa'ang tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs rgya cher bsngags shing*/

lha sngags thams cad 'di ji lta ba ni bla med ma rgyud he ru ka'i rigs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud 'bum pa na bzhugs par gsungs/ gang ltar yang byin rlabs kyi tshan ka gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di la bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag mtha' yas su bzhugs pa las/ re zhig bdag bskyed la brten pa'i bsnyen pa tsam bya bar 'dod pas/ gnas dben par tshe dpag med kyi sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba'i mdun du zlum gtor pad 'dab can gnyis sam gsum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ ra ba bzhi sogs yar ngo'i gza' skar sbyor byed shis pa'i nyi shar nas brtsams te mtshams dam du bcad la/ thun bzhi'i rim pas bdag bskyed sgrub thabs ltar bsgoms la bzlas pa bya/ thun thams cad kyi mthar mchod bstod gsol gdab/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod bcas dang*/ thun gnyis sam phyi thun gyi mjug tu gsol gdab kyi rjes/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum la brten pa'i a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas dbul/ gsum pa yod na gzhi bdag gtor chog ltar btang*/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas tshe dpag med rten la brtan bzhugs dang*/

badz+ra muḥs rten med pa rnams gshegs/ gnas gsum bsrung ba dang bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rtags mthong ba/ 'bring dus bsnyen zla ba drug tham ma grangs bsnyen gzungs ring 'bum phrag bzhi dang snying po 'bru 'bum mam/ de gnyis gang rung la bya bar gsungs kyang*/ gtso bor snying po 'bum phrag bcu gcig kha skong bcas bzla ba phyag len du mdzad do// bsnyen pa grol khar sgrub pa'i mtshon byed dngos grub blang bar mos na/ mdun bskyed kyi rten dbang chog ltar bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun rten yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod bsdu na dbang chog ltar dang*/ spro na rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// tshe dang ye shes stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar la phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul/ gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta brjod la rol mo bya/ de las rgyas par mos na rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga spyi ltar sbyar bas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa sogs nas/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis mdzad pas bstod/ tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas pa bya/ thun bsdu ba na mchod bstod gsol gdab/ gtor ma phul ba nas bzod gsol gyi bar byas la/ ye shes pa mdun rten la brtan bzhugs dang*/ gtor mgron gyi 'jig rten pa badz+ra muḥs gshegs/

gnas gsum bsrung ba dang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ de ltar zhag gsum mam bdun sogs su bya/ grol rgyu'i thun tha mar dbang gi dmigs pa rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du gsal btab la dngos grub blang*/ tshe zan spyi bor bzhag tshe ril dang tshe chang myang*/ rjes su gtor mgron gsar du spyan drangs pa yin na de la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod bzod gsol bya/ ye shes pa bris sku sogs kyi rten la brtan bzhugs dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams badz+ra muḥs gshegs/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgya cher byas la mtshams grol/ sbyin sreg 'di nyid kyi man ngag las dmigs bsal ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ spro na dpa' bo gcig grub las/ mar dang til gyi sbyin sreg gis thams cad zhi bar byed do// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang ba spyi'i cho ga ltar bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo til la grangs bzung ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ des mtshon te tshe spel ba'i slad du dūr wa la grangs gzung ba'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg sogs kyang sbyar du rung ngo*// sbyin bdag gi don du bsnyen pa byed na/ rang gi thugs kar bsgrub bya spyi ltar bsgoms nas tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas pa byas kyang rung mod/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don dran pas rang dang bsgrub bya ngo bo dbyer med blo 'das brjod bral du shes par byas nas de'i ngang nas lha bsgom pa sogs bgyis pas kyang don 'grub par man ngag rig pa rnams kyis gsungs la/ spro zhing skabs su babs na bsnyen pa thon rjes/ sgrub pa gong ltar mthar bsgrub bya la tshe dbang bskur nas 'chi med kyi dga' ston spel na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro// las kyi tshogs la/ 'di rang gi man ngag las 'byung ba ni bcud len la brten nas tshe sring ba'i thabs khyad par can kho na tsam du snang zhing*/ gzhan 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan 'brum bu srung ba/

dug zhi ba/ sngags mdud kyis zhi ba/ nad spyi dang bye brag sel ba/ byis pa gso ba/ mngal srung ba/ g.yul las rgyal ba/ byabs pas nad sel ba rnams gsungs te/ de rnams kyang 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas ji ltar rigs pa bsgrub na 'phral dang yun du phan bde'i dge mtshan 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rab byin rlabs kyi cho ga pad dkar bzhad pa'i phreng ba dang gtso bor rjes su 'brel ba'i gsal byed kyi yi ge nyung gsal snying por dril ba 'di yang*/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba ste/ dge bas 'gro kun tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā kal+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
